scope: The standard ordinary candidate-domain projection immediately before the already closed ordinary property-38 completion/selection boundary. It is limited to entities already present in OrdinaryTurnTimeline.action_order.
selected_model: Project ordinary candidates from the immutable timeline's prior action-list order. Retain an entity only when its explicit ordinary_action_eligible participation flag is true and settled SurvivalState.alive is true. The projection does not inspect target selectability, action-resource legality, behavior-level ActionDelayState modifiers, or pending inserted-action records. It is therefore the closed ordinary alive/action-domain filter, not a general legal_actions implementation.
state_writes: none; returns a deterministic ordered ordinary candidate identity tuple
the consuming ordinary completion boundary records the selected candidate set in its trace
ordering: Life-state filtering occurs after settled HP/death state and before ordinary candidate sorting. The projected tuple preserves prior action-list order; the downstream property-38 comparator supplies stable remaining-delay ordering.

evidence.support: R4/R3 ordinary death contract removes DEAD entities from the ordinary action domain before a subsequent ordinary action selection.
The ordinary AV model consumes an eligible action list and keeps special action systems outside its scope.
The existing Semantics-29 runtime owns a distinct ordinary participant list; this reference projection retains that scope and does not turn target selectable state into action eligibility.

strict_rejection: candidate entity absent from the timeline
using target selectable state as a substitute for ordinary action participation
implicitly scheduling an inserted action from the pending queue
implicitly applying a behavior-level ActionDelayState modifier to property 38
unsupported_boundary: terminal/wave handling when no ordinary candidates remain
special, summon, memosprite, boss-part or replacement participant derivation
Advance Forward, delay, turn-skip consumption, Ultimate/FUA/ExtraAction/Immediate Action/interrupt composition
dsh_implementation_contract: Store ordinary action participation independently from target selectability. Build the ordinary candidate tuple only from the current ordinary timeline in prior action-list order, requiring both ordinary participation and settled alive state. Feed that tuple to the property-38 AV transition. Do not broaden this projection into a general action-legality or special-action scheduler path without an explicit contract.
